_source_note: Hand-curated (not bulk-aggregated like flight_stats.json/hotel_stats.json) from ASI (Archaeological Survey of India) official entry fees and museum-published pricing, cross-referenced across multiple sources as of early-mid 2026. Unlike flight/hotel data, no clean bulk dataset of real Indian attraction prices exists publicly -- attraction visits rarely get captured as priced transactions the way bookings do. Coverage is intentionally limited to fee-gated historical/cultural sites (monuments, museums) in the 4 cities also covered by the hotel service, since that's the only category of attraction with a real, verifiable, published price. Beaches/nightlife/food/nature categories have no equivalent real fee data and are NOT covered here -- the activity agent falls through to Google Places or mock data for those. Some sources disagreed by 2-3x for the same site (e.g. CSMVS museum quoted anywhere from Rs60 to Rs200 for Indian visitors depending on source/date) -- the most recent, most-corroborated figure was used in each case, but treat these as approximate and re-verify before any production use.
